cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I want potatoes; you want pizza. First to peel five chooses. I've done four.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order pizza unless you can find a cheaper dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Potatoes cost nothing. They're already here. I win.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got a voucher. Pizza's free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then best free dinner wins. I'll cook potatoes, you order pizza, and Mum can judge. She always asks for my potatoes.
